name: IED spikes (hand-sorted)
note: Hand-sorted IEDs, imported from PTEN_M13_pten_m13s17aug4. 906 events from the detector; 288 were rendered and filed by hand and the rest were never looked at, so they are unspecified rather than rejected. Filed: 37 Flag, 195 Garbage, 43 Solid, 13 Sputter. Times are the MIDPOINT of the table's on/off pair at 30000 Hz, which is what the review images are aligned to; the onset is 2*start - end. `Evt###` is a 1-based row of that table. Both established by measurement -- see tools/import_ied.py. Version 2 keeps only the Solid events -- 43 of 906 -- so the set can be plotted without filtering. The fuller version is still v1; nothing was deleted.
units: seconds relative to the start of the recording
